campaignsText: Team Pcp's campaign demonstrates a focus on disrupting critical software supply chains. They likely use compromised maintainer accounts to insert malicious code, as seen with GitHub account 'pl-ghost'. This incident highlights their ability to manipulate trusted repositories and packages, suggesting ongoing operations beyond this event.
description: Team Pcp is a sophisticated threat actor targeting supply chains through PyPI packages, compromising widely used libraries like Lightning to inject malicious code. Their primary focus appears to be credential harvesting and disrupting CI/CD environments, with similarities to the Shai-Hulud campaign.
goals: Team Pcp aims to harvest credentials and disrupt software supply chains, likely to gain long-term access or intelligence. Their targeting of widely used libraries suggests a focus on maximizing impact and persistence in critical IT ecosystems. Typical victims include organizations utilizing popular Python packages and CI/CD tools.
